summary: Python imports come right after the RETURN block, using explicit imports (no wildcards), placed after the docs strings to keep them near the functional code.
questions: Why are imports after the documentation in Ansible modules?
Are wildcard imports allowed in modules?

answer_card.title: Module import placement
answer_card.answer_md: Imports go immediately after `RETURN`, e.g. `from module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule`. Wildcard imports are not allowed. They come after the doc blocks because those are effectively docstrings, keeping imports near the code that uses them.
